title: MZ Guide help using Visustella MZ plugins.

posts.author: GYIYGABITE
posts.body:
Not sure if this is the right spot but to post it but here goes:
I'm making my game using RPG Maker MZ along with Visustella MZ Tier 1 plugins. Is there a guide on how I can customize the menu interface beyond the parameters? For example, I want to set it on the left side as a column but making the menu interface smaller or bigger for example. Or for example changing the size of certain window interfaces as well as moving them.
I'm sure I can tweak using javascript but I have zero knowledge of it for the moment.
Also, how can I combine for example a Save/Load menu instead of having it individual?
Thanks in advance.
